release_notes: The full 1152×720 playfield now scales cleanly inside the website and on narrow screens, keeping the HUD and both touch zones visible.
Tap the left half to invert gravity; tap the right half to cycle red → green → blue. Keyboard mirrors are included for desktop play.
Matching enemy bullets damage your three-point hull, off-color bullets phase harmlessly for graze bonuses, and automatic shots only damage matching enemies.
Fifteen color-authored enemy variants attack with escalating aimed and fan patterns, capped by a recurring multi-phase Chroma Warden boss.
Missions, streak multipliers, shield pickups, waves, distance, accuracy, local best score, and run summaries give every attempt structure.
Parallax space art, animated explosions, ship trails, impact shake, color glows, CC0 action music, and layered sci-fi effects deliver a polished arcade presentation.
